slides.title: Three questions before you *buy it*
slides.sub: Ten seconds at the register saves a closet later.

slides.title: Where will it live?
slides.body: If you can't name the shelf, drawer or hook, it's going on the counter. Then the chair. Then the closet.

slides.title: What will it replace?
slides.body: Something new in means something old out. If nothing goes, ask if you need it at all.

slides.title: Next week, would I still want it?
slides.body: Leave it in the cart for a week. If you forget about it, you have your answer.
